decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan 1:1250, P001, P002, P01, P011, P012, P013, P0110, P111, P112, P020, P021, P022, P023, P030, BNG statement, Planning Fire Safety Strategy, Planning Fire Safety Plan, CIL form, Highway Safety Impact Form, Planning Statement.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied by more than five residents at any one time without first obtaining the approval, in writing, of the Local Planning Authority.   Reason: To ensure that the future occupation of the building does not adversely affect the adjoining premises/immediate

No cooking facilities, including hot plates, shall be installed in the bedrooms of the development hereby permitted unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. Any cooking facilities shall thereafter only be implemented in accordance with the details that have been approved pursuant to this condition.  Reason: To accord with the stipulations of definition as a House of Multiple Occupation and to safeguard the residential character of the surrounding area.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until details of the 5 long stay cycle parking spaces have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  These details should demonstrate: Location :Near entrances or main access  Design: Stands or wall bars  Security: Secure, overlooked, well-lit  Coverage: Covered where possible  Accessibility: Step-free, no obstructions  The cycle parking spaces shall be fully constructed in accordance with the approved details prior to first occupation and shall thereafter be retained for the lifetime of the development.   Reason: To ensure that adequate cycle parking facilities are provided to promote sustainable modes of transport.

Notwithstanding the existing Block Plan drawing number P002, no car parking is permitted within the development site as submitted as there is no dropped kerb and safe means of access.Reason: To control the level of parking on the site and to safeguard the uses of other areas

Means of Enclosure   The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until the means of enclosure for pedestrians and cyclists has been approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The development shall be implemented in accordance with the details. Reason: To ensure a safe, secure, and accessible environment for all users of the development, including pedestrians and cyclists, and to maintain the visual quality and functionality of the site.

The development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until waste storage and recycling facilities to satisfy the future number of occupiers on site have been provided within the development, in accordance with the Enfield's Household Recycling and Waste Planning Guidance for New Developments (February 2024). Such facilities to be retained for the lifetime of the development.  Reason: To ensure that adequate waste and recycling storage facilities are provided to meet the needs of future occupiers, promote sustainable waste management practices, and support borough-wide recycling targets.
